title: SceneObject: bad parentId is invalidProperties
description:
Oracle: jmap-chat-spec 6bcd9d8 (quoted text). Mapped by wf_6712c4f8-c2b.

[scene] SceneObject/set: nonexistent parentId must be invalidProperties naming parentId
Spec (): draft-atwood-jmap-scene-00.md L1768 (Create Errors, invalidProperties table): "| `parentId` does not reference an existing SceneObject | The parent object must exist (within the same region). |" (the separate notFound table was removed); L1809 (Update Errors): "Same field-level validations as create: ... circular `parentId`, excess hierarchy depth."
Code: crate-jmap-scene-server/src/object.rs:361-368 (check_parent depth==1 branch returns SetErrorType::NotFound); crate-jmap-scene-server/src/object.rs:331 (doc: "is `notFound`"); crate-jmap-scene-server/src/object.rs:611 (same helper used on update); crate-jmap-scene-server/tests/object_set.rs:395-402 unknown_parent_is_not_found
Now: check_parent returns a NotFound SetError when the immediate parent does not exist, on both create and update.
Change: Return invalid(&["parentId"], "parentId does not reference an existing SceneObject"). Fix the doc at object.rs:331 and update the test oracle to L1768 asserting invalidProperties/["parentId"]. The shared helper changes the update path too; see decisions_needed.
notes: Mark 2026-10-20 DECISION: Scene: policy access via existing may_access_region -> invalidProperties(regionId); narrow may_enter_region to ban/cooldown -> forbidden. Dangling parentId/visualRef on update -> invalidProperties, same as create.
